name: Kambar
credit: No portrait: no authentic likeness of Kambar exists
bio: Kambar (Kamban) is the great poet of Tamil epic, traditionally placed in the Chola period of the twelfth century and said to have lived at Therazhundur in the Kaveri delta. Little else is securely known of his life; the stories told about him, including his patron Sadaiyappa Vallal of Tiruvennainallur, come from later tradition.

His masterpiece is the Ramavataram, called Kamba Ramayanam after him: a Tamil re-making of the Rama story, not a translation of Valmiki, in six kandams (books) of about 10,500 stanzas, mostly in the four-line viruttam metre. This archive holds its first book, the Bala Kandam, from Tamil Wikisource's transcription.
